comment: Governance, consent, and privacy are grouped together as supporting lawful AI use. Consent may not be the applicable legal basis for all care, public-health, research, or administrative AI use.

anchor.note: p.106 l.Lines 66-69 read as the printed page; section 5.2 agrees

public.text: Governance, consent, and privacy are grouped together as supporting lawful AI use. Consent may not be the applicable legal basis for all care, public-health, research, or administrative AI use.
public.suggestedRevision: Refer to lawful basis, purpose limitation, transparency, consent or preference where applicable, access control, oversight, and data-subject rights as distinct governance mechanisms.
